description: The complete Belgium income tax computation for 2026, as on the return. Covers: Federal scale and the belastingvrije som on its own scale, with increases for children, dependants, single parents, disability; Joint assessment: huwelijksquotiënt and transfer of unused tax-free amounts between spouses; RSZ 13.07%, sociale and fiscale werkbonus, bijzondere bijdrage sociale zekerheid; Forfaitaire vs actual professional costs; expat regime (35% allowance); Regional surcharge (Flanders, Wallonia, Brussels) and gemeentebelasting per municipality; Federal reductions (pensioensparen, langetermijnsparen, childcare, gifts, replacement income) and regional ones (Flemish woonbonus, Walloon titres-services); and more. Returns the tax, the balance still to pay or to be refunded after taxes already paid, every option the law offers compared, and each step with its legal reference. All amounts in EUR; everything is optional, give only what applies. What is not modelled is listed in the result.

inputSchema.description: Belgian personal income tax return (personenbelasting / impôt des personnes physiques), income year 2026 (assessment year 2027), for one person or a married / legally cohabiting couple. Amounts in euros for the whole year; leave out what does not apply.

capital_gains.description: Gains on shares, funds, bonds and crypto sold from 1 January 2026 (meerwaardebelasting)

carried_exemption.description: Unused exemption carried forward from earlier years, per person, euros (max €5,000)

bought_before_2026.description: You already held it on 31 December 2025 (its value that day replaces the cost if higher). Default false

kind.description: ordinary (10% above €10,000 a year), substantial (stake of 20% or more: 0% up to €1M), internal (sale to your own company, 33%). Default ordinary

owner.description: taxpayer, partner or joint. Default taxpayer

withheld.description: Capital gains tax already withheld by banks, euros for 2026

childcare.description: Childcare for children under 14 (kinderopvang): 45% reduction, max €17.30 a day per child

days.description: Days of care, all children together

dependants.description: People who depend on you (personen ten laste)

children_under3_no_childcare.description: Children under 3 for whom you claim no childcare costs (+€740 each)

dependants_65.description: Parents, grandparents, brothers or sisters aged 66+ or in need of care living with you (+€5,950 each)

disabled_children.description: Of those, children with a disability (count twice)

single_parent.description: You live alone with your children (alleenstaande ouder, +€1,980). Default false

donations.description: Gifts to approved institutions (giften), at least €40 each: 30% reduction, max 10% of income, euros for 2026

late_interest_rate.description: Late-payment interest (nalatigheidsinterest), percent a year (art. 414: between 4 and 10, set yearly). Default 4

married.description: Married or legal cohabitants: joint assessment (gemeenschappelijke aanslag). Default false

months_late.description: Full months the balance was paid after its due date (two months after the assessment notice). Default 0

dividends.description: Dividends: 30% withholding (roerende voorheffing); first €833 per person exempt via the return, euros for 2026

interest.description: Interest on bonds and term deposits: 30%, euros for 2026

savings_interest.description: Interest on regulated savings accounts (spaarboekje): first €1,020 per person exempt, rest 15%, euros for 2026

withheld_at_source.description: A Belgian bank already withheld the tax (roerende voorheffing). Default true

municipal_rate.description: Your municipality's surcharge in percent (0-10), overrides the default

municipality.description: Municipality for the local surcharge (aanvullende gemeentebelasting): antwerpen 7%, gent 6.5%, brugge 6.9%, brussel 4.9%, liege 8%, other 7%. Default other

partner.description: Your spouse or legal cohabitant (only used with married): income and personal items

actual_costs.description: Actual work-related costs you can prove (werkelijke beroepskosten); leave out to get the flat 30% (forfait), max €6,070, euros for 2026

age.description: Age on 1 January 2027 (66+ for both spouses raises the marital quotient cap). Default 40

bbsz_withheld.description: Special social security contribution withheld (bijzondere bijdrage sociale zekerheid), from the same fiche, euros for 2026

benefits_in_kind.description: Taxable benefits in kind (voordelen van alle aard), e.g. company car; taxed but no social security, euros for 2026

disabled.description: Recognised disability of at least 66% (+€2,030 tax-free). Default false

foreign_halved_income.description: Resident: professional income earned and taxed abroad in a country without a treaty (tax halved, art. 156), euros for 2026

pension.description: Pensions (pensioenen), statutory and supplementary, taxable part, euros for 2026
